reason: E-Golf4U is going away, so I have to move 950 members to something that will still be there in ten years, and two founders with one club not even live yet is not something I can defend to my board. The price and the escrow promises are fine, but I'll go with Nexxchange or IntoGolf, which other clubs around us already run.
objection: There's no track record. Zwolle isn't live yet, and your pilot has volunteers carrying on in our current system while E-Golf4U is being retired, so what am I running in parallel with? Plus most members will ask why they need this when GOLF.NL already books and takes payment.
would_change_my_mind: Zwolle running live for a full season with a results page and a board I can call that says members actually use it, before our deadline for choosing.
